Structured developmental records

A large record system can preserve observations across a child’s developmental journey, supporting continuity and review.

Reported in the 7 September 2026 handout. Database row/event counts at 17 July 2026.

What this figure counts

Session entries, assessment observations, technique ratings and other structured events. The evidence does not identify every record as an AI-training example or establish clinical effectiveness.

Definition & source historySRS 4400 factual findingsSAE 3000 · 2.5B floor
Dated institutional count
31 million+

Cumulative therapy services reported

The useful family question is how the experience recorded across services informs a clear plan and review for your child.

31,052,382 under the practitioner reports’ service-counting criteria, at 17 July 2026.

What this figure counts

The defined total includes assessments, screenings and parent training. It is not established as 31 million successful one-to-one therapy sessions; service volume and clinical success are separate measures.

Service definitionSAE 3000 scope & UDINSRS 4400 scope & UDIN
Management update · inventory not inspected
1.3 lakh

Early-intervention technique repository

A technique library is useful when a practitioner selects and adapts activities to a child’s goals, interests and everyday routines.

130,000 techniques: management-supplied update received 18 September 2026. The 7 September handout reports an earlier 90,000+ library.

What this figure counts

The updated repository count has not been reconciled to a dated inventory extract. The reviewed UDIN reports do not establish this figure, and technique count does not mean 130,000 separately validated interventions.

Updated figure & evidence scopeEarlier published library count
Dated institutional count
7.9 lakh+

Beneficiary / family registrations reported

Behind each registration is a family seeking support. A family’s own goals and progress reviews remain the measure that matters to them.

792,614 unique beneficiary/family registrations under the stated criteria, at 17 July 2026.

What this figure counts

This is the defined registration measure. It is not a count of unique children with independently verified outcomes, and it does not itself measure family empowerment.

Countries of family origin reported

Families may connect with developmental support across borders, including through remote delivery where available.

Company-reported international reach in the July 2026 dossier, including remote delivery.

Centres in the reported network

A network becomes relevant locally. Find your centre, its facility identifier and the source behind each listed document.

Network figure reported in the September handout. The practitioner-report criteria separately identify 49 operational centres at 17 July 2026.

What this figure counts

Network size, operational status and HFR identifiers are different measures. The full supplied HFR workbook is reconciled with certificate copies below; an HFR entry does not establish clinical outcomes or replace location-specific licensing.

Complete HFR evidenceNetwork vs operational definition49-centre factual findings

How the evidence connects

UDIN identifies a practitioner’s report. HFR identifies a health facility. A company publication or management update supplies a stated figure. Each answers a different verification question.
